description: Screenshot of a verified tweet thread by Daniel Goldman (@danielsgoldman), dated Oct 14 2020, disputing the New York Post story about a hard drive obtained by Rudy Giuliani. Goldman claims Giuliani has been conspiring with Russian agents and, in a reply, questions why the FBI would subpoena the computer, notes Burisma was hacked by Russia, and warns against spreading Russian election interference. These are the author's claims, not verified facts.
text: Daniel Goldman. @danielsgoldman. Before more journos go peddling this @nypost story, they should do some diligence on the cover story for how Giuliani got the "hard drive." Giuliani has been conspiring with Russian agents for months, including someone the US says is actively trying to interfere in this election. 8:55 AM - Oct 14, 2020 - Twitter for iPhone. 5.7K Retweets. 203 Quote Tweets. 15.1K Likes. Daniel Goldman. @danielsgoldman - 6h. Replying to @danielsgoldman. Why would the FBI subpoena the computer? If the store owner could give it to Giuliani, he could give it to the FBI. Makes no sense. And let's remember, Burisma was hacked last fall by Russia. Do not be complicit in spreading Russian efforts to interfere in the election. 129. 2.4K. 8K.
flags: Tweet asserts unverified claims that Giuliani conspired with Russian agents; archived as a claim, not endorsed

description: Screenshot in dark mode of a Parler post by the account GenFlynn (@GenFlynn), associated with Michael Flynn, posted 44 minutes before capture with 44k views. The post addresses '#DigitalSoldiers', urging followers to respond with facts and sound analysis, asserts America is a constitutional republic not governed by any one media platform, and urges readers to ensure their vote counts.

Allowing tyranny to reign over liberty keeps us from breathing freedom's fresh air and informing our democracy of the grave threats our constitutional republic faces. Read, listen, understand, comprehend and respond with facts and sound analysis. That is how Digital Soldiers Fight back. America is a constitutional republic where supreme power is held by WE THE PEOPLE through our duly elected representatives and not any one media platform. Ensure your vote counts. GOD BLESS AMERICA

description: Political cartoon by Ben Garrison (GrrrGraphics.com) titled 'Biden's Bodyguards'. Two hulking bodyguards with a Facebook logo and a Twitter bird for heads block a citizen holding a paper reading 'U.S. Citizen Reveals: Biden Scandals!!' and shove away a man carrying a NY Post newspaper labeled 'real journalism'. Behind them, caricatures of Joe Biden and Hunter Biden (holding a money bag) stand while Joe says to make sure Russia doesn't interfere with his election. The cartoon claims social media platforms censored Biden scandal stories to protect his campaign.
